brief:
Tucker Carlson Network is promoting Israeli author Avrum Burg's book "Peace Is the Only Final Solution for Jews" through its publishing platform. The network describes the work as available exclusively through TuckerCarlsonBooks.com.

Burg, a former speaker of the Israeli Knesset, has become known for advocating dialogue and reconciliation between Israelis and Palestinians. His book title invokes language of finality in addressing the conflict between the two peoples.
dek: We are proud to offer Avrum Burg’s book ‘Peace Is the Only Final Solution for Jews’ only at TuckerCarlsonBooks.com.
title: Publisher promotes Burg book on Israel-Palestine peace
